doubts.q: The Meeting details row has no mid-row title card, but the labels switch from the edit flow (Meeting Details, Editing, Adding others, Save updates, send-update modal) to "User Details" and two "Inline team popup" frames, and the frame names restart (171, 2, 3, 170). Is this one journey or two?
doubts.proposedDefault: Two journeys on one card: meeting-details (5 steps, ends on the "Send an Update to Invited People?" modal) and meeting-details-people (171 -> User Details -> Inline team popup x2). The trailing "bigger screen" 1440/1920 pair is kept as references on meeting-details.

doubts.q: Three rows sit on 1504x945 macOS desktops, not 1440 web frames: Desktop — the Mac app (10 frames), Notification dropdown for teams (3), System Tray Dropdown (1). The Desktop card links to a separate desktop.html. Should the React prototype build these as a simulated Mac desktop, or keep them as references only?
doubts.proposedDefault: Build them as a separate /desktop route: a 1504x945 desktop canvas with the 1320x779 app window, menu-bar tray and notifications. The 1504 size is the window chrome around the app, so the 1440 rule does not apply to it.

doubts.q: System Tray: the frame embeds a rich tray panel (meeting list + Recording/Stop). Beside it are light and dark copies of that panel, plus light and dark copies of a compact native menu (Open Unify Brain, Stop recording, Meeting Dictation, Calendar Reminders, Quit). Which menu is the tray click, and is dark mode in scope?
doubts.proposedDefault: Left-click on the tray opens the rich panel (the one in the frame). The compact menu is the right-click / secondary menu. Light only; the dark copies are references.

doubts.q: In Cues, Native recording and Templates the frame names (export numbers) disagree with the left-to-right order: Cues 174,175,176,178,177; Native recording 187,185,186,188,189,194,190,192,196; Templates 173,179,183,180,181,182. None of these rows has designer labels. Which order is the journey order?
doubts.proposedDefault: Left-to-right layout order, as everywhere else. The numbers look like capture order from the HTML prototype linked on each card.

crossPage.note: Note card 8890:594271 hyperlinks to Chat + Artifacts "Canvas comments" (card 1969:507282, journey canvas-comments) and "Publish artifacts flow" (card 1969:507280, journey publish-artifact). Steps "Version History" and "Apps dropdown" repeat the header dropdowns of Chat + Artifacts journey header-dropdowns (card 1969:507284).
"Brief with artifacts" shows artefacts inside a brief; it should open the Chat + Artifacts artefact views (artifact-view-editor-main / artifact-full-editor).
Ask about this meeting is a chat scoped to a meeting; probably reuses the composer and answer layout of Chat + Artifacts chat-artifact.
Invite and who's-here overlap with Chat + Artifacts add-users, collab-chat and share-artifact (invite collaborators). Check whether the invite modal is the same component.

Onboarding frames carry a Main_nav instance, and the other web frames are built from "Meetings / Brief-page" instances that probably include the same nav. That nav is the one mapped in Chat + Artifacts nav-light / nav-behaviour.
Desktop notifications, snackbar and meeting reminders probably overlap with the Notifications page (mapped separately).
